title: collapse_by_thread uses HashMap<Id, bool> where HashSet<Id> is correct
description: email.rs:707 — seen_threads: HashMap<Id, bool> used as a 'seen' set, checking .insert(tid.clone(), true).is_none() to detect first-time insertion. HashSet::insert returns bool directly with the same semantics and expresses intent. Suggested rewrite: let mut seen_threads: HashSet<Id> = HashSet::new(); if seen_threads.insert(tid.clone()) { result.push(id); }
